label: Simulation: synthetic rotation schedule on the real main canal, not a water order, not a real WUA schedule, not a legal ranking

round.note: round A starts 07:00 on day 1 of the dekad; round B takes the second half of the dekad's 12-h slots (07:00 day 6, or 19:00 day 6 in an 11-day dekad)

pumps.day_use: only when the round's volume does not fit the remaining night slots; flagged

periods.rule: July: owner-approved periods; other months: interval = min(RAW, Dmax x Ef) / net need per day, RAW = p_adj x TAW, p_adj = p + 0.04 (5 - ETc per day) clipped 0.1-0.8, P = clamp(floor(interval / round days), 1, 4)

shortage.skippable: other green field outlets only, never twice running; skip pointer moves one rotation group per round from the head end

round_fill_share_note: assumed: a round's turn volumes (at the head) are shortened by priority to at most this share of the round's head supply; the rest covers canal fill-and-drain and the packing of whole hand streams and 12-h slots
season_start_dekad: first dekad of the year with head supply above zero
assumptions: the main canal pools absorb the travel-time difference inside one slot (capacity is checked on the slot plan); transit storage = water released at the head that has not yet reached its offtake (0.7 m/s); fill-and-drain = canal fill after 12 h dry, booked as loss; rain skips and events (outages, cleaning) wait for the operations input (D7)
